crossRefs.note: I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked…
My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
and with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to Yahweh…
and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for…
Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of…
All these were under the hands of their father for song in Yahweh’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and…
The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.
I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill.
This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
As for me, I will call on God. Yahweh will save me.
Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.
I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.
I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

translations.web: My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.
translations.bsb: I cried out to God; I cried aloud to God to hear me.
translations.kjv: I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear
translations.asv: I will cry unto God with my voice, Even unto God with my voice; and he will give ear unto me.
